research_question: Under an equal eight-question budget on a fixed KNIGHT linear-algebra recognition bank, does a soft conjunctive-prerequisite Bayesian learner model with information gain reduce mastery Hamming error compared with an additive pairwise-prerequisite model using the same information gain?
population: Synthetic static six-binary-skill learner profiles, not human participants. No teaching, learning transition or feedback during assessment.

primary.metric: mean normalized Hamming error at budget 8
primary.contrast: pairwise_ig minus hyperedge_ig; positive favors hyperedge
primary.uncertainty: paired bootstrap over 20 held-out worlds, 10000 replicates seed 990001, percentile 95% CI; report all worlds and null/negative results

item_selection.source_complexity: metadata only, not an empirically calibrated item difficulty

worlds.rng: NumPy SeedSequence([world_seed, namespace]) with namespaces 1=world parameters, 2=learner mastery/ability, 3=item parameters, 4=potential-response uniforms, 5=random policy. All methods use same learner profiles and pre-sampled item-wise uniforms within a world. Distinct worlds across regimes and splits. Policy receives independent policy RNG only, not world seed.
worlds.rule: Only development worlds accessible to tuning; freeze parameter manifest and code hashes before evaluation. Never retune on held-out outcomes. Bootstrap seed independent.

generator.root_mastery: Each root probability independently U(0.35,0.75) per world; sample roots as Bernoulli.
generator.child_mastery: Bernoulli sigmoid(b_j+w_j*f(parents)+u); independent world-specific b_j U(-1.8,-0.6), w_j U(1.5,3.2). u=0 matched; u=Normal(0,0.4) per learner noisy; u=Normal(0,0.6) mismatch. f=product of parents matched/noisy; mismatch uses additive mean and deletes S4->S6 or S2->S3 with equal probability per world. No deterministic prerequisites. Generator not exposed to policy.
generator.matched: Conjunctive generator with candidate parent sets (positive control; does not establish empirical validity). DINA response: P(correct)=1-slip if all Q-tagged skills mastered, otherwise guess; item slip U(0.06,0.18), guess U(0.18,0.30).
generator.noisy: Same conjunctive parent sets but fresh worlds. DINA slip U(0.15,0.30), guess U(0.20,0.35); learner ability variation in child mastery.
generator.mismatch: Independent worlds with altered prerequisite structure and additive parent function. Compensatory item response sigmoid(logit(0.25)+2.5*mean mastery of tagged skills+0.8*u-d_q), item difficulty d_q U(-0.6,0.6). u is learner ability from child generation. Not the inference likelihood. One potential Bernoulli response per learner/item, shared across all policies.

inference.state_space: 64 binary profiles; exact enumeration, nonzero priors, static state
inference.common_prior: Factorized DAG conditional prior. For each root fixed r; for each child sigmoid(b+w*f(parent)). Shared candidate parent sets and identical number of tunable parameters for both model classes. f=mean of parents in pairwise additive comparator, f=product of parents in conjunctive model (single-parent identical). A general pairwise graph can encode conjunctive CPDs; claim limited to these explicit model classes, not expressivity of all pairwise graphs.
inference.common_likelihood: DINA with a single fitted slip s and guess g per model, identical Q-tags. P(correct|z,q)=1-s if every tagged skill mastered else g.
inference.update: Posterior proportional to prior times likelihood over observed history, exact enumeration, normalize; marginal mastery >=0.5 predicts mastered.
inference.information_gain: H(Y|history,q)-E_{z|history}H(Y|z,q), binary response entropy in nats. Same scoring and tie break for both IG methods.
inference.tuning: Fit each prior family with same 32-point grid using fixed random eight-item histories on development worlds only, objective average learner mastery marginal Brier at budget 8 averaged equally over regimes/worlds; evaluator may use development truth, policy never. All baselines using a given family reuse its fitted settings. Ties choose lexicographic grid tuple. Save selected settings and development summary before held-out test. Do not tune on outcomes from evaluation worlds.

methods.random: Uniform over remaining eligible items/families, pairwise model posterior. Isolates question selection against pairwise IG.
methods.pairwise_static_bkt: Pairwise prerequisite Bayesian knowledge-tracing adaptation for static assessment; no learning/forgetting transitions, same pairwise prior and likelihood; selects item maximizing mean p_j(1-p_j) over Q-tagged skills. Explicitly not a full sequential teaching BKT benchmark.
methods.pairwise_ig: Additive parent conditional prior, exact Bayesian posterior, information gain.
methods.hyperedge_ig: Conjunctive parent conditional prior, exact Bayesian posterior, information gain.

secondary_metrics: Hamming error and exact mastery profile accuracy versus budget 0..8
Questions to first exact recovery (evaluate using hidden truth; failures report censored at 9 and report success proportion, no oracle-based stopping)
Mastery marginal Brier score at budget 8 and 10-bin ECE (equal-width bins, sample-weighted; descriptive)
Predictive response Brier score over selected questions, predicted before answer; descriptive because selections differ
Wall time per policy/world, same hardware; exclude generator and plotting
analysis: All regimes reported separately, mismatch primary, matched and noisy secondary. All policies on same worlds. Report paired means/CI of primary contrast and all method means. One plot: Hamming vs budget, three regime panels or mismatch only plus separate table; no cherry-picking. No significance claim if CI overlaps zero; no empirical student claims. Record item family and selected question IDs.
required_tests: Verify data hashes, tags, no exact duplicate question strings and >=8 distinct families
Check priors/posterior normalization and finite IG; same one-parent model condition
Check equal budgets and no family repetition; exact deterministic replay

Policy isolation: identical observed history + candidate graph + RNG yields same choice when hidden truth/true graph/future answers are intervened on; API cannot receive hidden state, generator or evaluator seed
Behavioral sanity on a deliberately discriminative toy world, no forced superiority on held-out test
Assert disjoint seed sets and refuse held-out execution until a frozen fitted manifest exists
Verify actual plot and summaries against saved per-world metrics
falsification: If mismatch contrast <=0 or uncertainty includes zero, no evidence of robust hyperedge advantage. Matched-only advantage is a positive-control outcome, not validation. Poor tags, conceptual recall and correlated items limit generalization. No claims of novelty or effectiveness with actual learners from this demo.
status: Design frozen before simulator implementation, no dev tuning or held-out experiments run yet. Corrections require version bump and documented pre-evaluation amendment.
